meaning:
κλάσμα, -τος, τό
(κλάω), [in LXX for פַּת, פֶּלַח ;]
a broken piece, fragment: Mat.14:20 15:37, Mrk.6:43 8:8, 19-20, Luk.9:17, Jhn.6:12-13 †
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They all ate, and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.
They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.
They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”
